key_features.classic_presentation: ONSET: Sudden onset. LOCATION: Unilateral chest. DURATION: Acute, persistent until treated. CHARACTER: Sudden chest pain, dyspnea. AGGRAVATING: Exertion, lying flat. RELIEVING: Sitting upright, chest tube. TIMING: Acute, sudden. SEVERITY: Moderate to severe (6-8/10). ASSOCIATED SYMPTOMS: Sudden chest pain, dyspnea, cough, anxiety. KEY POSITIVES: Sudden onset, chest pain, dyspnea. KEY NEGATIVES: No fever, no wheezing.
